title.zh-CN: OSK 皮肤包与 lazer 编辑支持
title.en-US: OSK skin packages and editing lazer exports

summary.zh-CN: 开发预览：直接导入 OSK 创建可编辑副本，修改素材与配置后导出新包，保留原始皮肤包和 lazer JSON 布局
summary.en-US: Development preview: import OSK packages into editable copies, export changes as a new package, and preserve the original package and lazer JSON layouts

zh-CN: 新增文件菜单导入与导出、首页导入按钮、OSK 拖拽和 Ctrl+Shift+O / Ctrl+Shift+E 快捷键
导入时创建持久的独立工作副本，自动打开并保留最近记录，原始 OSK 不修改
编辑配置、图片、音频和皮肤设计后可导出新 OSK，导出前选择应用当前修改、仅导出已保存内容或取消
保留包内子目录、动画与音频，单层包装文件夹自动展平，缺少 skin.ini 的有效包在副本中补最小配置
保留 lazer 的 skininfo.json 与控件布局 JSON 原始内容，当前预览使用传统 Standard / Mania 素材，原生组件请在 lazer 中确认
兼容旧版 lazer 导出包里的零字节目录记录，重新导出时生成正常目录结构
en-US: Add file-menu import and export, a home import button, OSK drag and drop, and Ctrl+Shift+O / Ctrl+Shift+E shortcuts
Create a persistent independent working copy, open it automatically and keep it in recent skins without modifying the original OSK
Export configuration, image, audio and design changes to a new OSK; apply pending edits, export saved content only, or cancel
Preserve subdirectories, animations and audio, flatten a single wrapper folder, and add a minimal skin.ini to valid packages when needed
Preserve original lazer skininfo.json and layout JSON bytes; the preview uses legacy Standard / Mania assets, so check native components in lazer
Handle legacy lazer zero-byte folder records and export a clean archive structure

zh-CN: 导入导出显示进度并支持取消，失败或取消不会留下半成品或替换已有目标
检查 ZIP 路径、CRC、文件数量与展开大小，拒绝路径逃逸、符号链接和损坏内容
导出不包含编辑器历史快照与素材备份，不覆盖导入来源的原始 OSK
保留多线路更新、签名校验和旧版备份流程，离线公告仅包含当前 r8 说明
en-US: Show import and export progress with cancellation; failure or cancellation does not leave partial output or replace an existing target
Validate ZIP paths, CRC, entry counts and extracted sizes; reject escaping paths, symbolic links and damaged content
Exclude editor history and asset backups from exports, and protect the original source OSK
Keep multiple update routes, signature checks and backup recovery; offline notes cover only this r8 build
